message:
Command `cat > /workspace/analysis.json <<'JSON'
{"sample_id":"arvo_20061",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson",
    "line":2648,"var":"idTypeDecoded","code":"atoiUnsigned(idTypeEncoded, size, &idTypeDecoded)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"The Type field value 22 is parsed from attacker-controlled JSON input, identifying the Variant body as ExtensionObject"},
   {"step":2,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson",
    "line":2655,"var":"dst->type","code":"dst->type = bodyType",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Variant type is set to ExtensionObject (typeKind=21), routing to the unwrap path"},
   {"step":3,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
    "line":2975,"var":"dst->type","code":"dst->type = typeOfBody",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Variant type is overwritten to LocalizedText (found via TypeId i=21)"},
   {"step":4,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
    "line":2978,"var":"dst->data","code":"dst->data = UA_new(dst->type)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Heap memory is allocated for a zero-initialized LocalizedText struct"},
   {"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"LocalizedText_decodeJson",
    "line":2226,"var":"dst->locale","code":"String_decodeJson(&dst->locale, ...)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Locale field decodes successfully, allocating a heap string inside the LocalizedText"},
   {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"LocalizedText_decodeJson",
    "line":2227,"var":"dst->text","code":"String_decodeJson(&dst->text, ...)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Text field decode fails because JSON value 0 is JSMN_PRIMITIVE not JSMN_STRING, CHECK_STRING rejects it"},
   {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
    "line":2994,"var":"dst->data","code":"UA_free(dst->data)",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"On decode error, dst->data is freed but dst->data and dst->type are NOT set to NULL, leaving dangling pointer and stale type"},
   {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"UA_decodeJson",
    "line":3338,"var":"dst","code":"UA_deleteMembers(dst, type)",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Cleanup on error calls UA_deleteMembers on the Variant which still has non-NULL type and freed data pointer, triggering use-after-free in LocalizedText_clear"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson",
     "line":2648,"operands":["idTypeDecoded"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
     "line":2994,"operands":["dst->data","dst->type"],
     "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"dst->data","right":"NULL"}},
   "sink":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"UA_decodeJson",
     "line":3338,"operands":["dst->data","dst->type"],
     "relation":{"op":"ne","left":"dst->data","right":"NULL"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson",
       "line":2648,"operands":["idTypeDecoded"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
       "line":2975,"operands":["dst->type"]},
      "type":"data","via":["bodyType","typeOfBody"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"typeOfBody->typeKind","right":"UA_DATATYPEKIND_EXTENSIONOBJECT"}},
     {"from":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
       "line":2978,"operands":["dst->data"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
       "line":2994,"operands":["dst->data"]},
      "type":"data","via":["dst->data"]},
     {"from":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject",
       "line":2994,"operands":["dst->data"]},
      "to":{"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"UA_decodeJson",
       "line":3338,"operands":["dst->data"]},
      "type":"data","via":["dst->data"]}
   ]
 }}
JSON` executed with exit code 0.
